## Status

Version **0.0.100**: full scope. It is not yet proven on real projects. Results are recorded in `tests/e2e`.
Codex as implementer is supported (real use, 2026-10-23 to 25); other Codex roles are not yet verified in real use.

## Install

Requirements: Git and POSIX `sh`.

```text
/plugin marketplace add furkansarikaya/proofline # add the marketplace

# a comment line
/plugin install proofline@proofline
```

**Skills only**: `npx skills add furkansarikaya/proofline`
